# Source origin

`WS_Patch_Tools` is an original implementation for IPS and BPS plus an adapter
to the external xdelta3 executable.

References:
- https://github.com/Sir-Walrus/Flips — release v198 / commit `359d414cff73b3e0400871d3c288a59b36564834`
- https://github.com/jmacd/xdelta — release v3.2.0 / commit `ff322e592383227b0d65ddfde7e0e5bbc504dc15`

No Flips or xdelta source/binary is included in v0.1.1.
